headline: Public hearing on property tax exemptions for residential, open space, and small commercial properties for FY 2027.
summary: The hearing covers exemptions for homes, open space land, and small businesses. It also sets the share of the tax levy each property class will pay.
items: Residential exemption of up to 35% of the average assessed valuation of residential property
Exemption of up to 25% for all property that may be classified as Class II - Open Space
Partial tax exemption for all qualifying small commercial properties
Setting the percentage of the Tax Levy each property class will bear in FY 2027
location: Great Hall, Searles Building, 3rd. Floor, 41 Pleasant Street, Methuen, MA 01844
plain_text:
Methuen City Council 
Great Hall, Searles Building, 3rd. Floor
41 Pleasant Street, Methuen, MA 01844
City Council Public Hearing, Monday, December 7, 2026, 
6:30 PM
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING METHUEN CITY COUNCIL
The Methuen City Council will hold a Public Hearing on 
Monday, December 7, 2026 at 6:30 p.m. in the Great Hall 
at City Hall 
AGENDA: Property Tax Classification Public Hearing to 
consider the following policy decisions (FY 2027):
1. A residential exemption of up to 35% of the average 
assessed valuation of residential property.  
2. An exemption of up to 25% for all property that may be 
classified as Class II - Open Space 
3. A partial tax exemption to all qualifying small commercial 
properties.  
4. A determination of the percentage of the Tax Levy to be 
borne by each class of property in Fiscal Year 2027
Neily Soto
Chair of the City Council
For residents wishing to view the meeting, please:
l Tune in to Channel 8 (Comcast) or Channel 32 (Verizon) 
l Watch the live stream at Methuen.gov/livestream
This meeting will be archived and viewable on demand within one to three business days at 
https://methuentv.cablecast.tv/internetchannel?site=2
Anyone needing an access accommodation to participate in City of Methuen programs or 
services, please contact Felix Garcia, ADA Coordinator at 978 -802-8001 or 
fgarcia@methuen.gov at least two weeks in advance, or two business days before any 
board or commission meeting. · This notice is available in alternative formats upon 
request.
